newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slipped at close on Thursday as individuals booked profits on early gains and are likely to open mixed on Friday, when local bourses switch their weekend to Saturday-sunday from Friday-Saturday.
"The market will move sideways as there is no news to set a clear direction," dealer Ali Asghar at Fortune Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 1.50 points, or 0.11 percent, to end at 1,412.25. Gainers led losers 131 to 105. Turnover fell to 16.31 million shares from 16.97 million on Wednesday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.10 to 20.90 rupees and Hub Power Co 0.05 to 31.45. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.15 to 24.75 and Pakistan Refinery 15.50 to 72.
Fauji Fertilizer fell 0.10 to 70.40. ICI Pakistan rose 0.50 to 18.50 and Searle Pakistan rose 2.0 to 29.
